governing_outcome: Make native UAOS entry reliably mandatory-but-lightweight, make depth/research/evolution internal routing decisions rather than pre-entry conditions, and turn broad learning into a reusable coverage-oriented evidence-acquisition capability that can discover, compare, falsify, integrate, stop and validate without creating a second cognition or research operating system.
evaluated_knowledge_findings: ENTRY_AND_ESCALATION_MUST_BE_SEPARATE: every selected UAOS/domain turn should enter a cheap mandatory sentinel; unknown/complex/systemic/deep signals decide escalation inside the sentinel rather than whether the sentinel runs.
SKILL_METADATA_IS_ROUTING_NOT_POLICY: description should be concise and scope/user-intent oriented; exhaustive symptom lists duplicate policy and increase context/trigger risk.

INSTRUCTION_LANGUAGE_NEEDS_DEGREES_OF_FREEDOM: positive operating invariants for contextual judgment, conditional decision rules for routing, hard MUST/NEVER only at genuine cliffs or fragile operations, scripts/gates for deterministic enforcement.
INCIDENT_PHRASES_BELONG_PRIMARILY_IN_EVALS: next/just-do-X/upper-layer/ten-rules are regression examples, not the highest-level behavior definition.

AUTONOMOUS_GOAL_LOOP_IS_THE_HIGHER_ABSTRACTION: while the governing objective is unfinished and no genuine blocker exists, select the next evidence-supported action, execute, verify and reassess until completion or a real stop condition.

INTERNAL_WORK_IS_NOT_A_USER_BLOCKER: cognition, evidence gathering, admission, candidate comparison and verification that the Agent can perform with available capabilities are work inside the autonomous loop; they cannot be relabeled BLOCKED merely because intervention admission is incomplete.

BROAD_LEARNING_NEEDS_COVERAGE_ORIENTED_ACQUISITION: source-role map, multiple seed lenses, query expansion, reference/repository snowballing, evidence extraction, method-family clustering, contradiction/falsification, triangulation, saturation and holdout.

SEARCH_SATURATION_IS_NOT_LITERAL_EXHAUSTIVENESS: stop only after required source roles/contradictions/candidate families are covered and successive distinct expansion rounds yield no material new family/failure mode likely to change the decision.
SAME_MODEL_SELF_CRITIQUE_IS_NOT_INDEPENDENT_JUDGMENT: external sources/tools/tests/runtime/holdouts are required when independent validation is material.

PREPROMOTION_NATIVE_HOLDOUT_HAS_TWO_ASSURANCE_SCOPES: installing candidate account projections while canonical bootstrap still targets main can validate account-side activation/projection behavior, but cannot by itself prove the unpromoted candidate canonical-owner path; post-promotion observation is required for that stronger claim.
EXISTING_UAOS_OWNERS_CAN_CARRY_THE_CAPABILITY: Deliberation + Deep Task + problem_space + Evolution can be extended; a separate Research OS would duplicate authority.

selected_intervention_candidate.knowledge_acquisition_owner: Extend src/uaos/kernel/problem_space.py with a coverage-oriented KnowledgeAcquisitionAssessment/Receipt rather than a new research state machine.
selected_intervention_candidate.deep_task_binding: DeepTask may require the acquisition receipt when broad method/framework/unknown-knowledge learning is materially required.
selected_intervention_candidate.deliberation_policy: Register coverage-oriented acquisition semantics and keep it subordinate to the canonical cognition kernel.
selected_intervention_candidate.native_entry: Redesign Custom Instructions/Skill projection around mandatory lightweight entry -> internal classification -> adaptive escalation -> autonomous goal loop.
selected_intervention_candidate.native_projection_salience: Project the existing canonical autonomous_goal_loop and problem-closure blocker_rule into the first mandatory-entry section so incomplete internal cognition/admission is not mistaken for a user-owned blocker.
selected_intervention_candidate.skill_metadata: Replace symptom-list description with concise runtime-dispatch scope; detailed routing remains body/canonical owners.
selected_intervention_candidate.regression_location: Move incident-specific phrases and near-miss cases into test/eval fixtures rather than making them governing prose.
selected_intervention_candidate.holdout_topology: Use natural fresh-chat account-projection holdouts for activation/behavior and post-promotion fresh-chat observation for current canonical-owner behavior; do not confuse candidate projection + old main authority with full candidate canonical validation.
selected_intervention_candidate.promotion_strategy: Repository-verify exact candidate, obtain account-projection behavioral evidence, promote through protected main, production-reread, then run post-promotion inheritance observation before closure.

verification_budget_interpretation: A verification round is one logical blocker-fix evaluation batch recorded as EvaluationResult.verification_round. Automatically triggered CI runs on intermediate commits inside the same blocker-fix batch are evidence but do not independently widen or reset the admitted round budget. State-only promotion observation reconciliation is closure metadata, not a new design verification round.
independent_findings_absorbed: Codex old-head P1 on stale CURRENT_SYSTEM was independently reproduced by CI and repaired by reconciling CURRENT_SYSTEM as a derived projection.

Codex old-head P1 on mutually exclusive no-op pointer tests was independently reproduced by CI and repaired by keeping autonomous-goal semantics in the contract while leaving the incident phrase in holdouts.
Codex old-head P1 on seed-search diagnostic was addressed by making the test use two non-expansion acquisition methods so it isolates the missing-expansion failure class.

Codex old-head P1 on saturation replay was accepted because a concrete bypass existed; admission now requires unique round ids, expansion work in each terminal round, distinct terminal work/evidence signatures, and non-novel terminal rounds, with targeted regression tests.
Native first holdout exposed an autonomous-continuation salience failure and a pre-promotion assurance-topology limit; both were addressed without adding incident-specific governing prose.

Native second holdout showed the repaired projection could recover from an early plan drift before mutation, preserve causal/repair candidate semantics, recover production authority, and reach NO_CHANGE without handing internal admission back to the user.
assurance_boundary: This evolution improves native behavioral routing and controlled-runtime evidence admission. It cannot create a repository-controlled native ChatGPT pre-send/pre-tool hook. The pre-promotion holdout validated account-projection activation/autonomous recovery but not unpromoted candidate canonical-owner behavior; post-promotion observation is required for closure.
